seed_status: Initial 5k sample (train_5k.jsonl, 4996 unique) evaluated in Stage 7.5; balanced 5k sample prepared in stage7_5-sample-v1.json (not yet trained)

training.sampling: Domain/type-aware selection, exact algorithm to be implemented and recorded
training.gradient_accumulation: Choose after measuring GPU memory; not fixed yet
training.overflow: Never silently truncate text or gold spans

evaluation.custom_span_metric_plan: Exact canonical type/start/end match; distinguish from official BIO metrics

comparison_protocol_plan.final_test_policy: Reserve official and independent service tests for final validation of selected models/settings; do not score every trial on these tests.
before_training: Confirm labels, chunking/overlap and original-codepoint offsets against B implementation
Measure M0 basic and dev-selected settings as separate experiments
Use a recorded fair dev selection procedure, search scope and resource budget for both M0 and M1
comparison_protocol_plan.ownership: Align with B serving configuration and reuse existing functionality; do not duplicate its runtime, rules or postprocessing.

comparison_modes.dev_selected_pipeline: Select M0 and M1 settings fairly on dev. Attribute the difference to the complete recorded pipelines.
comparison_modes.controlled_weights_only: When claiming an isolated fine-tuning effect, hold labels, thresholds, rules, chunking and postprocessing fixed across M0/M1.

comparison_protocol_plan.cumulative_change_interpretation: A -> B -> C differences are incremental effects in that order, including interactions; they are not independent effects.
comparison_protocol_plan.optional_single_factor_check: When needed, change one factor from a common M0 reference. Do not automatically run all combinations.

experiment_record_plan.rate_units: Rates in [0,1]; percentage-point deltas = 100 * (current - reference). Counts use count differences.
experiment_record_plan.zero_denominator_policy: Undefined with denominator 0; never fabricate 0% or 100%. PERSONAL_ATTRIBUTE has no gold support in the current dev/test splits.
experiment_record_plan.epoch_history: Link each epoch/checkpoint to train/dev metrics, configuration, artifact and selection reason; no final-test tuning.

stage_mapping.4: Implement metric/record schemas and fair comparisons
stage_mapping.5: Record M0 basic and dev-selected results
stage_mapping.7: Evaluate selected models/settings on final tests and generate improvement-history tables
stage_mapping.8: Hand off final settings, experiment history and reports

supplementary_dataset_candidate.conclusion: CC-BY-4.0 verified. 33 raw labels audited with 0 errors. Under 15 confirmed labels only 1,780 unique train documents survive. Retaining PRD standard K-PII-Bench without replacement.
